sources.title: XIR - Intermediate Representation | Xilinx/Vitis-AI | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: XIR - Intermediate Representation Relevant source files XIR (Xilinx Intermediate Representation) is the graph-based intermediate representation format used throughout the Vitis AI ecosystem. XIR defines the structure and semantics of neural network models after quantization and before deployment to DPU hardware.

sources.title: Vitis-AI/src/vai_runtime/xir/README.md at master - GitHub
sources.snippet: XIR includes Op, Tensor, Graph and Subgraph libraries, which providing a clear and flexible representation for the computational graph. For now, it's the foundation for the Vitis AI quantizer, compiler, runtime and many other tools.

sources.title: Large language models (LLMs) - Azure Databricks | Microsoft Learn
sources.snippet: These notebooks fine-tune and post-train large language models (LLMs) on AI Runtime. They cover parameter-efficient methods like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and full supervised fine-tuning across libraries including TRL, Unsloth, Axolotl, and LLM Foundry. For batch inference examples, see Batch inference.
